edges.reason: In the Owned constructor msg.sender is written into the owner state variable, so the caller controls who becomes owner.
The onlyOwner modifier used by changeOwner checks require(msg.sender == owner), so msg.sender gates this privileged function.
acceptOwnership compares msg.sender with newOwner before transferring ownership.
The _newOwner parameter of changeOwner flows directly into the newOwner state variable.
changeOwner writes its argument into newOwner, starting the two-step ownership handover.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable when the caller is the pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads the newOwner state variable to decide whether to complete the transfer.
SafeMath.mul performs the raw a * b multiplication modelled by the unsafe_operation node.
SafeMath.sub performs the raw a - b subtraction modelled by the unsafe_operation node.
SafeMath.add performs the raw a + b addition modelled by the unsafe_operation node.
mintToken calls SafeMath.add for totalSupply and balances updates.
mintToken's SafeMath.add calls execute the raw addition inside the library.
The maxTokenAmountNotReached modifier compares the new totalSupply against MAX_TOTAL_TOKEN_AMOUNT.
mintToken increases the totalSupply state variable by _amount.
mintToken adds _amount to balances[recipient], mutating the balances mapping.
mintToken's onlyMinter modifier asserts msg.sender == minter, so the minter state variable gates minting.
msg.sender is the value checked against minter in the onlyMinter modifier of mintToken.
The constructor parameter _minter is stored into the minter state variable.
The recipient parameter indexes the balances mapping that mintToken credits.
The _amount parameter is the value added to totalSupply and balances in mintToken.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for msg.sender and _to.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited account, so the caller controls the source balance.
transfer performs the raw subtraction balances[msg.sender] -= _value.
transfer performs the raw addition balances[_to] += _value.
The unchecked subtraction mutates the balances mapping stored in state.
The unchecked addition mutates the balances mapping stored in state.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for _from and _to.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
transferFrom performs the raw addition balances[_to] += _value.
transferFrom performs the raw subtraction balances[_from] -= _value.
transferFrom performs the raw subtraction allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
The unchecked addition in transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
The unchecked subtraction in transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
The unchecked subtraction in transferFrom mutates the allowed mapping.
approve writes _value into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
approve uses msg.sender as the owner key of the allowance mapping.
allowance returns the value stored in the allowed mapping for _owner and _spender.
The _to parameter is the credited key in transfer.
The _value parameter is the amount transferred in transfer.
The _from parameter is the debited key in transferFrom.
The _value parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
The _owner parameter is the mapping key returned by balanceOf.
The _spender parameter is the approved key in approve.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newOwner only exists inside changeOwner and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter _to is only meaningful as the recipient argument of StandardToken.transfer.
Parameter _value participates in the balance arithmetic of StandardToken.transfer and can be folded into it.
Parameter _from is only used by StandardToken.transferFrom and should be merged into that function node.
Parameter _owner is only used as the lookup key of StandardToken.balanceOf.
Parameter _spender is only used as the approval key of StandardToken.approve.
Constructor parameter _minter is stored directly into minter and belongs to the SharesChainToken constructor node.
Parameter recipient is only used as the credited key of mintToken.
Parameter _amount is only used as the minted quantity of mintToken.
